calendarNotes: The Volusia County Schools 2026-2027 calendar follows a traditional districtwide student calendar structure with student holidays, teacher duty days, professional development, one-hour early release dates, major break periods, and a weather-related make-up note. Thanksgiving Break, Winter Holiday, and Spring Holiday are the main family planning anchors, while early release dates and teacher duty days require closer attention for pickup, childcare, and campus-specific scheduling. September 21 is listed as a professional development day that will be used as an inclement-weather make-up day if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Volusia County school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Volusia County Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year for students on Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Volusia County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for Volusia County students is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Volusia County Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Volusia County Schools Spring Holiday runs March 15-19, 2027. Classes resume Tuesday, March 23, after a March 22 teacher duty day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Volusia County Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Holiday begins Monday, December 21, 2026. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Volusia County 2026-2027 date is an inclement-weather make-up day?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar identifies Monday, September 21, 2026 as a professional development day that will be used as a make-up day for inclement weather if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Volusia County Schools publish a Spanish school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Volusia County Schools publishes a Spanish version of the 2026-2027 school calendar, linked as an alternate official calendar on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: How many days are in the Volusia County school year 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The Volusia County Schools 2026-2027 student calendar includes 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Volusia County Schools calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the PDF link on this page or the official Volusia County Schools calendar page to download the printable 2026-2027 PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Volusia County Schools calendar include early release days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026-2027 Volusia County Schools calendar includes one-hour early release dates, mostly on Wednesdays with some Friday exceptions.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include Volusia graduation dates or testing schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Graduation dates, testing schedules, athletics, and campus events are usually published separately by individual Volusia County schools.
